scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Mateo’s Saturday pantry prep shift viable by ensuring the required kitchen footwear is available before he leaves home.
Emerging Need: The shift is only tentative at first; later, a closed-toe shoe rule combines with Mateo’s confirmed attendance and missing backup pair, leaving a prerequisite absent for a future check-in.
Decision Context: The pantry reminder defines the requirement, while a stored support record identifies the consented shoe source, wording boundary, and who can be asked.
Consequence: Timely coordination can put the existing sneakers in reach; after the family drop-off list closes, that prevention option no longer helps the morning shift.

parameter.title: Mateo Harbor Pantry prep shift
parameter.description: Tentative Saturday volunteer prep shift pending Mateo's week-of confirmation.

parameter.subject: Saturday prep-shift reminder
parameter.body: Reminder for Saturday kitchen prep volunteers: check-in requires closed-toe, non-slip shoes, and the pantry has no loaner footwear this week. Volunteers without the required shoes cannot enter the kitchen work area. Please arrive ready for the 8:30 AM start.

parameter.content: I’m keeping the Saturday pantry shift. My backup sneakers finally split, so I don’t have kitchen shoes at home right now.
I’m doing family porch drop-offs until 6 tonight, then driving out with my phone in airplane mode for the weekend. Anything that needs to go to Mateo has to be on the porch list before 6.
Porch drop-off list is closed and I’m leaving now. Anything not already listed won’t get moved before Sunday.
